Every evening, thousands of hammer-headed fruit bats depart their daytime roosts in search of mates, calling out through large, box-shaped snouts that give the flying mammals the appearance of a winged moose. Here, along the Congo River, scientists have been collecting DNA swabs and tissue samples from the bats for years, working deep into the night in spacesuit-like protective gear. items.title: How opencast mining risks reawakening dormant geological faults
items.summary: New study finds subsidence caused by groundwater extraction can take place as far as 20km from site of mine The impact of opencast mining goes far beyond the edge of the pit. Studies of an opencast coalmine in western Germany show that opencast mining triggered extensive subsidence in the surrounding area and re-activated dormant geological faults. Underground mines are often associated with ground subsidence, but less is known about the risks associated with opencast mines. Researchers from the GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences in Potsdam, Germany, studied satellite data and geological field measurements from the area around the opencast Rhenish coalfields, between Aachen and Cologne. articles.snippet: 청와대가 ‘내란 사건 특별수사본부’ 구성을 두고 고심하고 있는 것으로 전해졌다. 이재명 대통령이 김지용 중대범죄수사청(중수청)장 후보자를 지명한 것을 두고 더불어민주당 강성 지지층 일각에서 “내란 청산과 검찰 개혁 의지가 없다”는 비판이 나오고 있는 가운데 중수청 출범을 계기로 ‘내란 청산’ 의지를 부각하기 위한 취지로 풀이된다. 23일 청와대에 따르면 이 대통령은 미국·멕시코 순방 일정을 마친 뒤 특수본 구성을 지시하는 방안을 검토하고 있는 것으로 알려졌다. 청와대 관계자는 “김 후보자 지명을 두고 여권 내에서도 말이 많이 나오고 있지 않냐”며 “내란 세력 정리 요구가 계속되고 있다”고 했다. 다만 또 다른 청와대 관계자는 “특수본 검토는 일종의 아이디어 차원으로, 확정된 바 없다”고 선을 그었다. 일각에서는 조희대 대법원장의 대법관 재제청 요청 거부에 대한 강공책이라는 관측도 있다. 대법원이 지난해 5월 대선을 앞두고 이 대통령 공직선거법 위반 사건을 파기 환송한 것을 두

articles.title: Meta Connect 2026: The biggest news and announcements
articles.snippet: It’s about time for Meta Connect, the company’s annual product launch event. This year, given the company’s major focus on AI and wearables like smart glasses, it seems likely that we’ll see updates from CEO Mark Zuckerberg and his team on those categories. The company has been facing significant scrutiny because of how some users have been covertly recording other people using the glasses, meaning that one of the biggest announcements of the show could be its rumored camera-free pair. Connect has also traditionally been a venue for updates on Meta’s VR hardware and software. While the company has scaled back its VR ambitions, a recent leak seemingly revealing some kind of unannounced mixed reality glasses could indicate that Meta will show off new immersive headwear technology during the event. Zuckerberg’s keynote is scheduled to begin at 7PM ET / 4PM PT on Wednesday, September 23rd. Follow along with all of our coverage right here.
